reason: I already threw away most of the PRs that background agents opened for me, so 'PRs that passed your checks' does not convince me. Pre-alpha from one developer, running unattended on client code, is too much risk for us right now. If I try it at all, I run the free version on my spare Mac mini.
objection: Our clients may not allow AI agents on their code. Even when they do, I do not believe the overnight PRs will be good enough to keep rather than review and bin.
would_change_my_mind: A real trial on one of our own repos where most of the morning PRs actually get merged, plus a clear answer I can give clients about where their code goes.
